initial_executor.limitations: Evidence distinguishes between autosomal dominant, recessive, and X-linked forms; some genes like GDAP1 and LRSAM1 are primarily associated with recessive forms but have rare dominant reports. DNM2 is associated with dominant intermediate CMT. PMP22 is associated with duplication in CMT1A. GJB1 is explicitly excluded as X-linked.
